name: Sandra Marques
title: Director, Career and Technical Education, Newark Public Schools
bio: With 26 years of experience in the Newark Board of Education, Sandra Marques had the privilege of serving students, families, and communities in a variety of roles that have shaped who she is as an educator and leader. She began her career as a classroom teacher, spending six years building strong instructional practices and learning firsthand the power of relationships and high expectations. From there, she served as a vice principal for six years and then as a principal for 11 years, where she led school improvement efforts, supported teacher development, and focused on creating inclusive, high-performing school cultures. For the past two years, she has worked in Career and Technical Education, a role that has allowed her to expand access to college and career pathways for students across the district.

name: Liz Ngonzi
title: Founder & CEO, The International Social Impact Institute and Board Member & Chair, Ethics & Responsible AI Committee, American Society for AI
bio: Elizabeth Ngonzi is a Human-Centered AI Innovator, Executive AI Advisor, and Global Speaker with 25+ years of cross-sector experience at the intersection of technology, education, and social impact. She is the Founder/CEO of The International Social Impact Institute, Adjunct Assistant Professor at NYU, and Chair of the Ethics & Responsible AI Committee at the American Society for AI (ASFAI). Through her signature frameworks, Liz equips education and tech leaders to integrate AI in ways that are ethical, impactful, and human-centered. From advising ed-tech startups to global institutions, she brings a blend of strategic insight, emerging tech fluency, and values-driven innovation.
topics: AI Lessons From Other Sectors: What's Coming to Your Education Organization

name: Dr. Johanna Wetmore
title: Chief Vision Officer and Founder, Content2Classroom
bio: Dr. Johanna Wetmore helps educational publishers redirect resources from costly tech development back to curriculum excellence. With over 20 years of experience in educational publishing and technology, Dr. Wetmore has guided publishers through digital transformation strategies that eliminate technology distractions while delivering the usage analytics and efficacy data that districts demand for renewals. She specializes in helping publishers answer superintendents' critical questions without sacrificing focus on content quality. Dr. Wetmore holds an Ed.D. from Vanderbilt University and regularly speaks on sustainable business models for educational publishers in the Edtech space.
topics: Industry Perspective (Content provided by Content2Classroom): Stop Building Tech, Start Winning Renewals: How Publishers Can Focus on Content While Proving Results

name: Brian Cully
title: SVP, Corporate Development, Instructure
bio: Brian leads Corporate Development at Instructure. He is responsible for sourcing and executing M&A transactions that build upon the company's success and further accelerate its growth.
